name: Anju
source:
The young, pampered Imperial Princess of Yamato and the heiress to the throne of her father, the divine Mikado.
She speaks in the lofty, regal manner characteristic of high nobility, and possesses a unique innocence and naivety.
Adored by the people of her empire.

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/deception/home.html]official site[/url]]
